title: Names of the appointed land distributors
description: Moses receives the Lord's command on how the land of Canaan is to be distributed by casting lots among the nine and a half tribes, since Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh have already received their inheritance east of the Jordan. The priest Eleazar and Joshua son of Nun are appointed to lead the distribution, together with one leader from each tribe – among them Caleb son of Jephunneh from Judah.
